integrity: Proof is analytical. Exact fractions and gamma-product arithmetic checked in standalone standard-library program; numerical checks do not establish the infinite-size limit. Originality claims are limited to inspected primary literature and available scientific records.
scientific_limitations: Balanced complete two-class three-uniform substrates; equally timed (2,1)/(1,2) irreversible trimers; only terminal vacant-count distribution as initial size grows. No unequal partitions, finite-time rates, general spatial models or moment convergence are proved.
title: A quarter-power jamming law for bipartite trimer adsorption
